articleTitle: Recognition and Location of Mixed-type Patterns in Wafer Bin Maps
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Wafer map analysis is one of the most critical steps for monitoring wafer quality and tracking failures in the semiconductor manufacturing process. Defective dies on wafer bin maps (WBMs) usually cluster into specific spatial patterns, which contain critical information for cause identification and yield improvement. This paper proposes an effective pattern recognition and location approach for both single pattern and mixed-type pattern maps. A convolutional neural network is introduced to classify WBMs with the single pattern or mixed-type (non-overlapped) patterns after seed filling segmentation. Meanwhile, WBMs with overlapped patterns are located and classified through template matching method. Further, for assessing the impact of each pattern, the pattern sizes are calculated after pattern location. The overall classification accuracy in two real-world datasets reaches 91.2% and 84.3%, which demonstrates the proposed approach has excellent classification performance for WBMs with mixed-type patterns.

articleTitle: Conditional Generative Adversarial Network for Defect Classification with Class Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) is used for defect inspection during industrial manufacturing process. It uses optical instrument to snap the surface of products and identify defects through technique of machine vision processing. Deep learning and convolution neural network automatically produce the feature which are useful for identify the defect correctly. However, the class imbalance for number of defect samples and normal samples is typically in industrial process, which will lead to poor accuracy of deep learning model. This paper integrate pix2pix, a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), which can generate synthetic image automatically, to generate more defect images to adjust the data distribution for class imbalance. Eventually, this paper uses Dense Convolutional Network (DenseNet) to get better result of defect data classification with manipulated data than with original data.

articleTitle: Multi-bin wafer maps defect patterns classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In semiconductor fabrication, a wafer bin map (WBM) represents wafer test results for dies using pass or fail values. Determining defective dies patterns is important because different patterns are related to different causes of failure. It is a common phenomenon that multi-bin values of dies exist in a single wafer. The previous methods assumed that a wafer bin map consists of binary values according to the pass/fail of the test for each die. These methods are not very accurate in wafer failure patterns classification. In this paper, we propose the principal component analysis (PCA) combined variable selection criterion to extract dominant bin values in a wafer. Then, in the training phase, a nonlinear support vector machine (SVM) model based on the labeled wafers is trained. Subsequently, this model is used in the inference phase to test the defect pattern of any unlabeled wafer. Through simulated and real data examples, we show that the wafer multi-BIN maps classification performs effectively, even if there are many random defects in a wafer.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Manufacturing Data Lake in Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The manufacturing industry generates vast amounts of data today and modern semiconductor manufacturing is one of the key contributors to this tsunami of data. Efficient storage and analysis of data have a significant impact on productivity and profit. In this paper, we will explore design and implementation of a manufacturing Data Lake in Hadoop ecosystem and how the data is used to generate business intelligence.

articleTitle: An Improved Approach for RFID Network Planning: Introduction of Directional Antenna Reader
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is an important information acquisition method in intelligent manufacturing. Correspondingly, the integrity and reliability of the perceptive information in RFID network is largely determined by reader node layout, i.e., RFID Network Planning (RNP). Generally, current research on RNP is performed based on omnidirectional antenna readers. However, with the increase of the electronic tags and coverage rate, the problems of reader collision and load balancing will become more serious. To address this, an improved approach for RNP is developed by introducing directional antenna readers. Based on the radiation models of omnidirectional and directional antennas, a bi-objective optimization model considering the repetition rate of tags and load balancing is established. Furthermore, the genetic algorithm is applied to solve this model. Finally, the effectiveness of the presented method and the validity of solving algorithm are verified through a case study.

articleTitle: Bills of Standard Manufacturing Services (BOSS) Construction Based on focused Crawler
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: As an advanced manufacturing model, cloud manufacturing(CMfg) has made great progress in recent years. The concept of CMfg has been introduced to many industries. With the growing diversity of products, the complexity of cloud manufacturing service encapsulation is also increasing. To solve the problem of product-oriented service standardized encapsulation, the Bills of Standard Manufacturing Service(BOSS) has been proposed. It can systematically solve the problem of deployment, registration and management of cloud manufacturing services in the whole product life cycle. In this paper, based on the service ontology model, we proposed an automatic perfecting service information method of BOSS using the focused crawler technology. Combined with the case study, we verified the feasibility and effectiveness of this method. Finally, the application framework of BOSS in the cloud manufacturing system is further discussed.

articleTitle: A ResNet with GA-based Structure Optimization for Robust Time Series Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Time Series Classification (TSC) received wide attention in machine learning and data mining, and arise in a wide range of fields, such as scheduling, logistics, medical and health etc. How to overcome the noise in the time series datasets is one of the key challenges of the TSC. In this paper, we propose a hybrid Residual Network (ResNet) with a genetic algorithm-based network structure optimization for robust TSC, which is named as GA-ResNet. Although network structure optimization is one of the key ways to obtain an effective deep neural network model, but this structure optimization is a NP-hard problem. We design a genetic algorithm for the ResNet structure optimization. Several benchmarks are adopted to prove the effectiveness of proposed GA-ResNet compared with six state-of-the-art deep neural networks.

articleTitle: Bilevel programming model of low energy consumption AGV scheduling problem at automated container terminal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In this paper, we design an AGV (automated guided vehicles) scheduling problem bilevel bi-objective model, that aim for reducing energy consumption and improving efficiency. A bilevel heuristic algorithm was designed to solve the model. The numerical experiments show that the model proposed in this paper can further reduce the energy consumption of horizontal transportation operations while optimizing operation efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study on Quality Prediction for Smart Manufacturing Based on the Optimized BP-AdaBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: To accurately predict the product quality in smart manufacturing, this paper designs the BP-AdsysBoost model on the basis of BP neural network and AdaBoost algorithm. The BP-AdsysBoost model considers both the data characteristics and the technology advantages, which pays more attentions to the unqualified products wrongly predicted. To further examine the model, the 110560 data of smart manufacturing from German BOSCH company is used for this research. The proposed BP-AdsysBoost model is compared with the BP neural network and the unmodified BP-AdaBoost model according to prediction performance. The results show that the BP-AdsysBoost model has significant advantages in prediction accuracy and FDR, which proves its satisfied prediction ability for product quality in smart manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research on Human-Machine Task Collaboration Based on Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: A human-machine collaboration method based on real time action recognition is presented to achieve the collaboration between automated guided vehicles (AGVs) and human operators through the perception of tasks conducted by human operators. The process of action recognition is accomplished by a Kinect vision sensor and convolutional neural networks (CNN), and the methods of multiple features fusion and hierarchical cluster are applied in the process of action recognition. The utilization of action recognition technology can effectively shorten the expected waiting time, and can avoid the assembly line stagnation caused by human errors to a great extent. Finally, the experiment result indicates that the overall efficiency has been increased significantly after applying the method.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling of Cloud Manufacturing Resources Based on Bat Algorithm and Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: To solve the optimization problem of cloud manufacturing resources scheduling, the optimal model, which based on the object of accomplishing the task at the lowest cost and shortest time, is built. A new algorithm of cloud manufacturing resources scheduling, which combined the bat algorithm with cellular automata, is proposed. The ROV coding technique was applied to the bat algorithm for coding and decoding of the individual position vector and the velocity vector, So the scheduling problem with continuous is converted into discrete problem. The objective function is solved by using the bat algorithm, and the optimal solution is obtained. The final results proves the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Vehicle Routing Problem with Simultaneous Pick-up and Delivery Considering Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The vehicle routing problem involves the distribution of orders to customers over a time window by collected vehicles. As demand tends to be individualized and diversified, customer satisfaction weighs most in a company's standing interests, better sacrifice costs in some cases to satisfy customers, while the simultaneous delivery and pick-up emerges as resource-efficient and time-saving. In this case, an request composed of a given delivery, followed by a needed pick-up at one customer location. The optimization problem is modeled as a multi-objective model with simultaneous delivery and pick-up based on an improved fuzzy due-time window. The measurement of objective is in the form of minimizing the total length of vehicles' paths and the total service costs, as well as maximizing the sum of all customer satisfactions to enhance competitive service quality. Finally, an improved genetic algorithm is implemented to resolve the multi-objective vehicle scheduling problem. Computational results of a numerical example are performed to indicate the validity of the proposed model, showing that our suggested algorithm can produce improved customer- satisfied routes without substantially adding the total service costs and total distance travelled.

articleTitle: Analysis and reconstruction of Pharmaceutical Warehouse logistics delivery system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Based on the sum of the working time of the in-out stock orders, the scheduling model for the mixed command sequence of Stacker-AGV for Pharmaceutical Warehouse system was established. On this basis, the software PlantSimulation was used to simulate the layout before and after optimization. The simulation results show that the optimization proposed in this paper has a satisfying applicability for the pharmaceutical logistics warehouse system, and improve the storage efficiency of the logistics system.

articleTitle: Maturity Assessment: A Case Study toward Sustainable Smart Manufacturing Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Due to the rapid evolution of Internet of Things (IoT), the advantage of having smart manufacturing has been quickly recognized by the industry. Manufacturing companies are facing challenges of organizing an unprecedented technical integration of systems and factories across hierarchy, domain boundaries and life cycle phases. Many reference models and use-case are available in national and international smart manufacturing related studies. However, gaps between study and actual factory environment exist due to the less care of interconnecting of process steps toward smart manufacturing implementation. To make over the transformation of implementation effectively, methodology to identify the gaps and address appropriate solutions in practice is needed. This paper provides insights that help the manufacturing companies toward developing a practical process to achieve the ultimate goal of interconnecting every step of their smart manufacturing. Case-study that lower the entry barrier, and reduce the investment risk of the transformation process for the factory automation system is highlighted and validated.

articleTitle: Multiobjective Particle Swarm Optimization with Improved Selection Strategy for Route Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The Multiobjective Route Optimization (MORO) problem is an extension of the traditional single-object route optimization problem, which aims to find an effective path with several conflicting objectives. Many research studies used multiobjective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) to solve MORO problem, however, they cannot achieve satisfactory results in both quality and computational speed. In this paper, an improved selection strategy based multiobjective particle swarm optimization (ISSMOPSO) is proposed for MORO. The improved selection strategy tactfully combines the advantages of vector evaluated genetic algorithm (VEGA) and Pareto dominating and dominated relationship based fitness function (PDDR-FF). The selection strategy based on VEGA has a preference for the edge region of the Pareto front, the PDDR-FF-based selection strategy has the tendency converging toward the center area of the Pareto front, which preserve both the convergence rate and the distribution performance. The experimental results show that the convergence of ISSMOPSO is better than comparison algorithms, and the diversity is close to NSGA-II and SPEA2 but better than traditional MOPSO.

articleTitle: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Scheduling System in IC Design Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: With the global competition and short life cycle in semiconductor industry, the IC design companies try to keep their competitiveness. Besides the human resources and advanced technology, enhancing the speed of the development is an important method to enhance market share. IC designers usually use electronic design automation tool to shorten the development. However, the EDA tools and resources are expensive and limited. Hence, it becomes a critical problem to allocate the resources and schedule the jobs. This study aimed to develop an IC design job scheduling decision support system framework. The framework enhances the throughput and reduces the idle. This study implements the proposed framework in practice. The empirical study conducted in IC design company to validate the developed solution and model implementation.

articleTitle: An Improved AdaBoost Tree-Based Method for Defective Products Identification in Wafer Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Wafer test is one of the most significant parts of semiconductor fabrication. Effective data mining technologies will improve wafer prediction performance, which will contribute to production cycle time reductions, yield enhancement and final product quality improvement. This paper presents an improved AdaBoost Tree-based method to decrease the false fail rate of defective products in wafer test. Particularly, it focuses on a discussion about the low classification accuracy for the minority class of samples due to the imbalance of wafer test data set. In addition, the novel method is proposed to identify defective products in wafer test, which achieves higher separability between the majority class and the minority class as well as shorter test time. Finally, experimental studies on wafer test data set show that our algorithm has better performance than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics for Tool Health Monitoring in Panel Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Tool health monitoring and maintenance has become a more challenge issue for big data recently and is extremely essential in today's highly competitive environment in industry. Good monitoring approach and right maintenance strategy will be a great benefit to the company for reducing the cost and prolong the useful life of machines. Related researches have been studied based on different methods and approaches for investigating the health status of machines in many fields. In this study, we provide a data mining framework for monitoring the tool heal status under the partial least squares approach as we as the control chart construction. A real data from panel industry is applied to demonstrate our proposed research.

articleTitle: Cooperative hybrid EA for large-scale flexible job shop scheduling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Flexible job shop scheduling problem (fJSP), which belongs to the classic combinatorial optimization problem, is difficult to solve with exact methods. Evolutionary algorithm (EA) has been widely used for dealing with fJSP in recent years. Large-scale flexible job shop scheduling problem with high complexity is of great importance in a real industrial production environment and indicates an advanced requirement for traditional EAs. In this paper, we propose a cooperative hybrid EA (ChEA) to solve large-scale fJSP with the objective of minimizing the makespan. fJSP with significantly complex encoding and decoding procedure is simulated as a two-stage random key-based representation. An effective set-based random grouping paradigm is used to decompose the variables space and solution space into small scale ones, achieving cooperative co-evolution optimization. We employ the particle swarm optimization (PSO) based on Gaussian distribution and local best individual as the evolution algorithm. Local search of moving two operations on the critical path is adopted to enhance exploitation. Numerical experiments carried out on large-scale instances get competitive performances compared with state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Co-evolutionary algorithm with MRF-based decomposition mechanism for flexible scheduling with uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Flexible scheduling problem plays an important role in many real world applications as it can model many practical issues, such the power grid scheduling, the logistics scheduling, etc. Most researchers assume that the parameters used in flexible scheduling problems are fixed. However, the uncertain factors in real world problems cannot be ignored. In this paper, we consider the uncertain processing times which are modeled with the uniform distribution and design a hybrid coevolutionary algorithm with Markov random filed (MRF) based decomposition mechanism for flexible scheduling problem with uncertain processing times. All decision variables are decomposed according to the learned network structure and the parameters of MRF. The proposed MRF-based decomposition mechanism is embedded into a cooperative co-evolutionary algorithm which is named as CEA-MRF. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm compared with the state-of-the-arts.

articleTitle: Application of Taguchi method and finite element analysis in optimization of automobile roof technical parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: During these years, although some scholars have proposed many methods, there are large improving spaces for these methods to be applied in enterprises and it is worth to be studied further. In this paper, Taguchi method and finite element analysis are used to optimize the process parameters of automobile roof cover in an automobile Limited company. Firstly, according to the production experience, the gel temperature, welding pressure and welding time, which affect the quality of automobile, are determined. Then, the CATIA software is used to build the model of automobile roof and import it into ANSYS software for simulation experiment to determine the process parameters that affect the indentation and expansion index of skylight edge-rolling process. Then, the parameter design theory of Taguchi method and Minitab software are used to carry out orthogonal experiments on multi-factors. Finally, the response analysis of the factors to the noise-prevention ratio and the quality characteristic value is carried out based on the experimental data. The variance analysis of mean value and signal-to-noise ratio is used to determine the optimal combination of process parameters of automobile roof cover at different levels. Minitab software is used to predict the test results. The feasibility of the method is proved by comparing the prediction results before and after optimization.

articleTitle: An integrated control strategy for eco-driving of intelligent hybrid vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Minimum energy cost with comfort driving characteritics define the ideal human mobility. Recent technological advances in most of the Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADASs) equipped on electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) not only enhance the safety and/or comfort level but also present a significant opportunity for automated eco-driving. The research presented in this paper focuses on the integrated control for Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Regenerative Braking Control (RBC) of Intelligent Hybrid Vehicles (IHVs). Three key components are included in the integrated controller, which are the control strategy for ACC, the torque distribution strategy for regenerative braking and the coordinated control strategy between ACC and RBC. The integrated control architecture which is based on the coordinative mechanism of information flow, energy flow and substance flow is established, and a detail energy and powertrain analyses through simulation on a specific IHV are presented as well. A multiple domain system based co-simulation environment consisting of PanoSim-Trunk®, Mathwork Simulink® and AMEsim® is established to verify the proposed integrated control strategy. Validation of the effect for the integrated control is simulated in the typical urban scenarios. Simulation results show that the proposed integrated control strategy has a high effectiveness and reliability.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Slot Allocation in Ground Delay Program based on Estimation of Distribution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: This paper proposed one multi-objective optimization method for slot allocation problems in one of popular Air Traffic Flow Management (ATFM) measures - Ground Delay Program (GDP). Firstly, we make the formulation of slot allocation problems as bi-objective optimization problems of both maximizing fairness and efficiency. Secondly, one hybrid meta-heuristic algorithm named Estimation of Distribution Algorithm (EDA) combined with scenario-based simulation is proposed in detail to solve the stochastic optimization problems of slot allocation in GDP, including probability model construction, estimation, new solutions sampling, and simulation based on scenarios. Finally, experiment results based on case study and conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Research on Inventory Decision Based on Plant Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The control of inventory cost plays a vital role in company operation process. It is not only affects the company's operating cost and daily operations, but also related to the realization of the company's business strategy directly. The research object of this paper is a sales company with a single product type. The sales company adopts a fixed inventory strategy (\pmbs,S). In order to reduce the company's inventory cost, this paper analyzes in the cost composition of the company's two delivery methods and safety inventory, maximum inventory, check inventory interval, etc., using Plant Simulation software to build the inventory decision simulation model and optimize for its inventory strategy, and the multifactor two-level experiment and factor analysis were carried out through the Experiment-Manger module. The simulation results show that the “delivery option” has the greatest impact on the total cost of inventory between 90% and 95% of the service level, and it can be initially determined that the “delivery method” should be set to “Normal”, safety stock 20, the maximum inventory of 70, check the inventory interval of 1 month.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Intelligent Scheduling of Urban Rail Vehicle Mixed-model Assembly Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Mixed-model assembly lines are increasingly used in urban rail vehicle production, as demands increase, and varieties diversify. Therefore, it is necessary to study the scheduling problem of urban rail vehicle mixed-model assembly line to achieve efficient and low-cost operation, meet market demand. First, this paper introduces the problem of the scheduling of the mixed-model assembly line and proposes the scheduling objective of the mixed-model assembly line of the urban rail vehicle. Then, it establishes a scheduling model with the minimum part set, the blocking time and the hunger time minimized as the optimization objectives. In order to solve the scheduling model, it studies the scheduling model construction method based on Plant Simulation platform and the embedded genetic algorithm design. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the genetic algorithm-based scheduling method in the simulation environment.

articleTitle: Multiobjective Evolutionary Algorithm with Fast Convergence Strategy for Clustered Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Window
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The Clustered Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Window (CVRPTW) is an extension of the traditional Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP), which aims to find a high efficiency and feasible solution. In actual situation, the distribution of customer is not dispersed, but centralized in several regions. CVRPTW has greater research implications. Compared with Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Window (VRPTW), CVRPTW often has many constraints. The process of finding the optimal solution is more complicated, and the consumption of time resources is relatively large. Therefore, this paper proposes a multiobjective evolutionary algorithm with fast convergence strategy (MOEA-FCS) to solve CVRPTW. The fast convergence strategy divides the population into subpopulations, each of subpopulation evolves in different directions. Experimental results show that MOEA-FCS converges much faster than NSGA-II and SPEA2, the distribution of solutions is better than NSGA-II and SPEA2.

articleTitle: Chamber Mismatching Calibration with Adjusted Run-to-Run Regulation in Semiconductor Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Achieving the delivery requirements with respect to the volumes and quality at the same time in semiconductor fabrication requires critically controlling the process variability. One obvious issue resulted from the process variability is the machine/chamber mismatching. In the high-mix/low-volume production line, it is getting more and more challenging to match the chamber performance due to the complex manufacturing environment with complex re-entrant flows, diverse products of very different technologies, and unpredictable machine availability. An adjusted Run-to-Run (R2R) regulation is proposed in this research to analyze the mismatching issue by considering together the sensor data and the wafer metrology. After identifying the significant variables linked to the mismatching, a Virtual Metrology (VM) modeling step is performed and will be integrated into a multi-criteria optimization program to compute the corresponding recipe adjustments, i.e., the R2R settings. As a result, the sensor behavior and metrology measurements among parallel machines/chambers can be matched as close as possible.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Cold Chain Distribution Path and Stock in M Dessert Company
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Recent years, the demand of cold products has been increasing. Its main features are high quality preservation, small batch sizes, and diverse product varieties, which are in line with current consumption patterns. However, the influence of many factors such as the development of the cold chain logistics enterprises in China now, and the cost has entered a period of slow development. Cold chain logistics distribution and inventory strategy issues become the key to achieve the lowest cost or benefit maximization for cold chain companies. The text has researched the background of M dessert company, and from two aspects of multi-temperature coarrangement and inventory strategy of cold-chain logistics to study. Firstly, the cost as the objective function, considers the constraints such as cargo loading, and establishes a multi-temperature co-provisioning and integration optimization mathematical model under load constraints. The particle swarm optimization algorithm was improved and the improved particle swarm algorithm was used to solve the model. Taking M dessert company as an example, MATLAB R2009a software was used to solve the problem, and the effectiveness of the model was verified. Secondly, this paper establishes an inventory control model with the goal of maximizing profit, The inventory of cold chain products can create value. This paper takes profit maximization as an objective function, considers the overdue loss rate of foods and the time allowed in the warehouse, and formulates inventory control strategies. The various models and research methods proposed not only have a theoretical guiding role for M dessert company, but also can provide reference for other similar cold chain companies in the future.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Approach for Optimizing Manufacturing Parameters of Wire Bonding Process in IC Packaging Industry and Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In the wire bonding process, different setting value of manufacturing parameters affect the quality of the solder joints and the speed of wire bonding significantly. And when a new product is introduced, it is difficult to quickly obtain effective parameters simply by relying on the experience of the engineers. The study aims to propose a data mining framework to help the IC packaging factories to increase production capacity by reducing the number of downtimes and speeding up the wire bonding time. The proposed data mining framework employed random forest and XGBoost method to classify the occurrence of defect, MARS algorithm to predict the wire bonding time, and genetic algorithm to search for the manufacturing parameters. By exploring the production data, the proposed framework finally provides a set of recommended manufacturing parameters of the second bonding process. This study cooperates with a leading assembly company in Taiwan to validate the proposed framework. The empirical result reveals that it improves the packaging yield by 0.03%. The domain engineers can also find parameters more systematically and quickly by the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Cutting Parameters Optimization for Parallel Turning Machines with Energy Consumption and Tool Life Considerations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: This paper studies the scheduling problem of turning process in the identical parallel machine environment. Scheduling of turning machine is a case of controllable processing time scheduling since the processing time of turning operation can be adjusted by altering the cutting speed, feed rate and depth of cut. The determination of subdivision of depth of cut is another decision problem to be solved in turning operation. Since the determination of subdivision of depth of cut is a MINLP problem itself, the combination of the two problems makes the scheduling problem of turning machine very hard to solve. Our research objective is to build an effective approach to solve the minimization of the manufacturing cost and weighted tardiness cost in the scheduling of parallel turning machine with multi-pass turning. The robustness of the methodology and computationally efficient are demonstrated under different scenario settings.

articleTitle: Create Manufacturing Service with GAN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: A generative adversarial network based manufacturing service instance generator is proposed in this paper. During the training of the generative adversarial network model, we adopt Word2Vec model to represent manufacturing services in the form of numerical vectors. The accuracy of the generator gets 0.76 after training, and the synthesized data are good enough to extend the current datasets for the further study on manufacturing services.

articleTitle: State parameters prediction of fire using generalized regression neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Fire Dynamics Simulation (FDS) can be used to simulate the fire process accurately, but it is time-consuming and unable to meet real-time computing needs. Therefore, it is difficult to be used in fire rescue scheduling and guidance of crowd evacuation in case of emergency. To solve the above mentioned problem, a fire surrogate model using generalized regression neural network (GRNN) is proposed to predict the key state parameters of fire spread process. In the proposed surrogate model, datasets produced by the FDS are employed to train and test the generalized regression neural network. Experimental results indicate that the proposed fire surrogate model not only can satisfy the prediction precision, but also can reduce the computational time significantly. Therefore, the proposed fire surrogate model is a promising tool to assist fire rescue and crowd evacuation.

articleTitle: Autometic Generation of Dispatching Rule for Hybrid Flow Shop Scheduling based on Genetic Programming
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Genetic programming-based automatic heuristic generation is a hyper heuristic that can produce the key functions in a meta-heuristic for a problem. This paper studies the automatic heuristic generation method to automated generate dispatching rules for the hybrid flow shop scheduling problem, a classic scheduling problem with strong industrial background. First, a meta-heuristic based on list scheduling is given. Then a genetic programming is proposed to generate a dispatching rule which is to produce a job list in the metaheuristic. Experimental results indicate that the generated dispatching rules are superior to the classic rules.

articleTitle: Data Driven Quality Control of Cast Iron Based on Adaptive PSO-LWLR Thermal Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Rapid detection of the chemical compositions is of great significance to stabilize the quality of cast iron production, which is usually achieved by thermal analysis in front of the furnace. However, the traditional thermal analyzer usually adopts a fixed parametric mathematical model. Under complex and changeable working conditions (such as fluctuation of furnace burden, changes in process conditions and sample cup batches, etc.), the fixed model often causes large deviations in chemical composition detection, and its parameters are not easy to adjust, which greatly limits the popularization and application of thermal analyzers in front of the furnace. To this end, this study is devoted to exploring a more adaptive thermal analysis model. The temperature eigenvalues of cooling curves are taken as input parameters, local weighted linear regression (LWLR) algorithm is used for local fitting, and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize the bandwidth parameter of LWLR. Finally, a PSO-LWLR hybrid model is formed. In a large foundry, the thermal analysis temperature data and corresponding chemical composition data of more than 200 furnaces of hot metal were collected from actual production. By using the above PSO-LWLR model, and comparing with the multiple linear regression (MLR) model and BP artificial neural network (BP-ANN) model, it is proved that the proposed model can achieve higher prediction accuracy. Unlike the global model with fixed parameters, PSO-LWLR is a locally optimized Just-In-Time (JIT) learning model. It can build different optimized local models for different query samples, so it has stronger adaptability and robustness under time-varying working conditions.

articleTitle: Decision-making of a three-stage supply chain based on Big Data information costs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In the Big Data era, Big Data information (BDI) has been used in supply chain management (SCM). Data Company as an important BDI supplier should be included in a supply chain. Thus, to explore the investment decision-making problems of BDI and its effects on the pricing rules, a three-stage supply chain with one manufacturer, one retailer, and one Data Company was chosen. Meanwhile, four benefit models about BDI investment were proposed and analyzed in the environments of symmetry information and asymmetric information. Findings: Whether the manufacturer and the retailer was suitable to invest in BDI, it was influenced by the cost improvement coefficient. With the ascent of the cost improvement coefficient, benefits of supply chain members will reduce, and in different investment models, their prices show different change trends with the cost improvement coefficient.

articleTitle: A framework for planing and solving production problems with manufacturing knowledge reuse
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Orders come and go, but production problems (PPs) are forever for manufacturing enterprises. In order to keep high competition in the global product market, the philosophy of continuous finding and solving PPs is never out of fashion to pursuit the ideal “zero defect” goal for today's manufacturing enterprises. To achieve this goal, a framework based on PPs finding and solving to propel production activity state transition efficiently and improving the production competence is presented with three-layer structure made of production activity layer, production problems layer and problem-solving solution layer. Respectively, a production activity chain model is extracted to describe the real production phases in the production activity layer; a production problems layer is formed according to the production activity decomposed into production events triggering concrete problems and those problems are classified into passive production problems and active production problems in accordance with their source; a problem-solving solution layer based on integrating-reasoning-evaluating various manufacturing knowledge including of innovative methods, theories and tools, is outlined and assists the decision makers to make a right choose.

articleTitle: Knowledge component based on intelligent tooling design framework
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: From the perspective of process dimension and object dimension of tooling design, this paper constructs multidimensional tooling knowledge components, realizes effective organization, management and use of tooling design process knowledge, and clarifies the method of internal operation mode of knowledge components. It mainly includes knowledge of design rules, parameterization, 3D model and other related design resources in the field of tooling design. According to different types of knowledge, using a structured method to adopt to organize rules, defining the application steps of knowledge in knowledge components, and completing the operation mode of specific design tasks. Realize the automatic reasoning process of decision-making and reduce the human intervention in the process of tooling design. During the operation of knowledge components, the parameter values entered by designers directly determine the operation results of knowledge components. Realize the process integration from user input requirements to output results, which reduces the human-computer interaction during the task execution inside the knowledge component, thus supporting the operation of the intelligent design framework tooling.

articleTitle: Research on Product Positioning Optimization Modeling Based on Improved MNL and Its Solution by ABC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The diversification and individuation of users' requirements put forward higher requirements for decision makers to positioning products quickly and accurately. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved Multinomial Logit Model (MNL) for positioning design in the product development phase. For the vagueness of the customer's qualitative evaluation of the product, a cloud model is used to convert the qualitative evaluation into quantitative user preference data, that is, the evaluation cloud of the product attributes. The utility value of each attribute level is calculated according to the expected value of the evaluation cloud, and then the user preference value of the product is obtained by weighted accumulation, where the weights of product attributes are optimized by the expected value and entropy value of the evaluation cloud and therefore the subjectivity and inaccuracy of the current method of attribute weight set by experience is avoided. Then, the MNL model is used to calculate the customer selection probability of the product, and the product positioning model is established with the aim of maximizing the profitability of the product. Finally, the model is solved by the Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABC), and then the optimized combination of product attribute levels is obtained to determine the optimal product profile. At the end of the paper, the feasibility and rationality of the product positioning model and its solution method are verified by an example experiment.

articleTitle: Design of SCADA System for CNC Grinder Workshop Based on SIMATIC NET
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: The process of informatization promotes the development of the workshop's digitalization. In view of the deficiencies in the CNC grinder workshop, such as insufficient control of machine status, difficulties in capturing production data, and the inaccurate information feedback, etc., a SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system is designed to effectively control and monitor the whole grinder workshop for the enterprise information construction. Siemens S7-200 series PLC is used as the lower computer in this system, and the upper computer adopts the industrial control computer with two OPC clients installed. WinCC (Windows Control Center) is used as an OPC client to realize the real-time monitoring, another client developed in VB high-level language is used to increase the functionality of the SCADA system, including electronic board, takt time statistics, and efficiency analysis, etc. The on-site commissioning shows that this SCADA system realizes the data acquisition and equipment monitoring with strong reliability, high stability, convenient operation and intuitive interaction, laying the foundation for the enterprise information construction in the next stage.

articleTitle: Overall Supply Chain Effectiveness (OSCE) for Demand and Capacity Incorporation in Semiconductor Supply Chain Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Moore's Law indicates that the amount of transistors which can be accommodated on integrated circuit (IC) double every two years in semiconductor manufacturing industry. As a capital intensive and competitive industry, supply chains in the semiconductor industry feature high structural complexity and high demand uncertainty. In order to enhance the effectiveness of the enterprise, total resource management (TRM) for semiconductor industry is increasingly crucial. Past studies focused on measuring the effectiveness of either demand fulfillment or capacity utilization, but little researches have done for investigating the inter-coordination on both aspects. This paper proposes overall supply chain effectiveness (OSCE) for the incorporation of demand planning and capacity portfolio based on PDCCCR framework to evaluate the effectiveness of semiconductor supply chain industry. The proposed index is implemented in an empirical study based on a simulation model for semiconductor backend production. Finally, the paper concludes with the discussion of future research directions.

articleTitle: Comparison research on X-ray image quality defects detection algorithm in semiconductor manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: Detecting product quality defects through image recognition technology is one of the key technologies of intelligent manufacturing, and also an important step for enterprises to construct smart factory. In the capsulation step of the semiconductor enterprise, the internal wire bonding of the chip is easily to receive the interference and to produce the defects. Companies need to pick out defective chips to avoid them going to the market. Traditional way is to use artificial vision visual inspection, which may lead to low efficiency and high labor cost. This study intends to use machine vision detection method based on image processing technology to identify the defect of the chip and to replace the workers artificial detection work. This paper proposes two algorithms to solve such above problems. The template matching algorithm (TMA) is to determine whether the chip is defective mainly based on the standard template. The neighborhood comparison algorithm (NCA) mainly calculates similarity of the neighbor chips to judge the target chip's defects. The algorithm is implemented by Halcon software. A German semiconductor company has provided enough samples to support our research. The experimental results show that the two algorithms are effective in defect detection of specific products. The advantage of the TMA lies in its processing speed, but the applicability and accuracy of NCA is more excellent. The algorithm proposed in this study can be used for enterprise by being integrated into the actual detection process.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Layout and Display and Control Interface of the Shield Machine Main Control Room
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In the actual tunneling process of the shield machine, whether the human-computer interaction between the driver and the display and control interface can reflect the operation dynamics in time is the key to safe and efficient tunneling. Based on this, the anthropometry is comprehensively used to optimize the layout of the main control room working space in this paper. In view of the driver's slow extraction of the information displayed on the interface, the gaze tracking technology is used to extract the driver's eye movement data. Through the analysis of the eye movement data, it is found that the display interface is insufficient, and then the display interface is optimized. The first gaze time of the optimized display interface AOI 1 was shortened by 0.72s and the gaze duration shortened by 12.4s. The first gaze time of AOI 2 was shortened by 1.86s, and the gaze duration was shortened by 14.52s. This experiment verifies the rationality of the optimized interface and improves the ability of the shield driver to respond quickly in time to dynamic soil changes.

articleTitle: An Auto-carrier Loading Problem with Inter-set Costs in Urban Outbound Logistics of Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: This paper studies a loading problem arising in the urban outbound logistics of automobiles. The problem is to assign a given set of orders of finished cars to a given set of heterogeneous auto-carriers such that the cars can be loaded and delivered from a depot to multiple destinations. A value is given to each order to represent its urgency level, and an interset cost is defined among the destinations to estimate the transportation cost. The objective is to maximize the weighted total value of the assigned orders minus the total inter-set cost subject to a full-load constraint and a special loading structure. An integer programming model and a column generation based heuristic algorithm are proposed. In addition, parallel programing is tested in the computational experiments. Computational results show that our algorithm can generate near-optimality solutions for practically-sized problems efficiently, and outperforms the integer programing model and a rule-based method applied in practice.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Network Design for Industrial Waste in Industrial Clusters: Opportunities from Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Smart Manufacturing, Industrial & Logistics Engineering (SMILE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of industrial waste accumulation in industrial agglomeration area, reduce the hidden dangers of manual operation, relying on intelligent logistics and artificial intelligence image recognition technology, this paper proposes a kind of “waste recycling-artificial intelligence identification-classification distribution activation” industrial waste “self-identification” - Cloud distribution mode. Based on the refinement of the process of each node of the logistics network, a multi-objective mathematical model of the artificial intelligence-industrial waste reverse logistics network with the lowest overall cost of the network system and the lowest waste landfill rate was established. And using Lingo software to solve the problem, the optimized location scheme of artificial intelligence recycling classification center is obtained.
